field_values_person_link_index.name: field_values_person_link_index
field_values_person_link_index.where: "fathom"."field_values"."person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fathom"."field_values"."link_address" IS NOT NULL

field_values_planned_hire_link_index.name: field_values_planned_hire_link_index
field_values_planned_hire_link_index.where: "fathom"."field_values"."planned_hire_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fathom"."field_values"."link_address" IS NOT NULL

fields_type_settings.name: fields_type_settings
fields_type_settings.value: ("fathom"."fields"."type" = 'choice' AND "fathom"."fields"."list_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fathom"."fields"."visibility" IS NULL) OR ("fathom"."fields"."type" = 'link' AND "fathom"."fields"."list_id" IS NULL AND "fathom"."fields"."visibility" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "fathom"."fields"."multiple")

people_dates_in_order.name: people_dates_in_order
people_dates_in_order.value: "fathom"."people"."end_date" IS NULL OR "fathom"."people"."start_date" IS NULL OR "fathom"."people"."end_date" >= "fathom"."people"."start_date"
